text:
vik: Short check-in before planning: product requests we standardize 'fallback semantics' across routing policies. Too many ad-hoc behaviors.

sarah: Example: some routes fallback to cheaper quantized model, others fallback regionally, some do both. Need consistent policy ordering and a default fallback chain.

owen: Suggest policy precedence: 1) same-model degraded-mode (quantized, lower perf), 2) compatible model in same region, 3) model in alternate region (residency constraints considered), 4) reject with explanatory error. Default policy should be configurable per-tenant.

vik: Also require SLO propagation: if fallback increases latency beyond tenant SLA, bill adjustments or credits should trigger automatically. We need billing hooks.

eng-bot: tracker-bot: created issue FALLBACK-22 "standardize fallback precedence + billing hooks" assigned owen. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/FALLBACK-22

owen: Implementation notes: routing decision must capture chosen fallback step in trace; policy engine needs an ordered list; fallback on failure vs fallback on congestion differs in telemetry.

sarah: Action: Owen -> doc fallback precedence and sample policies; Vik -> prioritize in roadmap; Sarah -> product UI copy for policy editor.

vik: Aim: land in Q2 minor release with gating tests and two customers toggled on to validate.

sarah: +1
